text:
Introduction
This document
lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 every two months as indicated by M2
 in the title block
The first draft 
initiated by Mr. Helmut Canadian SISP, S/S specialist, and first approval at 08 
July 1996, first review date 03 March 2002, 
and second review date 15 Jan. 2006.
The document was updated by 
Ataka PS.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, i.e. safety shoes, 
 helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Isolation and proper earthing is
 required.
There is danger of falling off
 the top of the arrester when cleaning insulators or checking connections, wear
 your safety belt.
Tools and Equipment
Safety belt, and safety Helmet
Rags
Work to be carried out
Check porcelain for cracks, and chipped skirts.
Check for loose caps and tighten if necessary.
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces
If fitted, read and record discharge counter reading.
